text:
mira_sales: FYI - Sentinel Labs wants a 7-day POC. They plan to bring 'eos-guard-33b-sentinel_v3' (custom tokenizer + LoRA). Need catalog compatibility, quick perf estimate, and security gating.

sam_ml: Do they provide the HF repo or just tarball? Key: tokenizer vocab changes + whether LoRA alters output heads.

mira_sales: They'll share repo after NDA. Notes: +24 control tokens, LoRA adapters only, fp16 preferred. They want a p95 < 300ms for short chat.

catalog-bot: queued compat-scan for `eos-guard-33b-sentinel_v3`...
catalog-bot: compat-scan: base arch supported; tokenizer delta detected (+24 tokens). LoRA adapters OK. FP16 supported. Recommend tokenizer-mapping shim.

anya_security: Security flags: EU data residency, minimal logs for POC, and BYOK? They asked about customer-managed keys. Need questionnaire.

kai_infra: If BYOK + VPC peering, private deploy. Hosted possible with IP allowlist and KMS proxy but slower legal. Ops note: tokenizer mapping breaks prefix cache until warmed.

oliver_ops: I'll draft a cost estimate: hosted POC (consumption) vs 1-week dedicated reserve. Ballpark hosted delta: ~$700 per 1M tokens for this family. Will refine once we know token volume.

sam_ml: I'll produce a perf baseline on a mocked variant (fp16 + added tokens) — need 24 example prompts. ETA 36h.

mira_sales: Action list: @ren_ae confirm legal timeline, @anya_security gather initial checklist, @kai_infra confirm whether hosted KMS proxy is acceptable, @sam_ml run perf. Demo window: week of 6/2.

ren_ae: Legal: NDA + DPA needed. Can turn in ~5 business days after NDA. I'll inform the customer.

mira_sales: Thanks all, I'll request repo and questionnaire from Sentinel. :thumbsup:
